description: Web Components let you make your own HTML elements with browser tools. A custom element can group a small piece of behaviour and style. Build one greeting first, then learn how it receives values. Run these HTML examples in this site's HTML playground. Each example defines its own custom element in a fresh page. No extra JavaScript library is needed.
versionNote: Uses autonomous custom elements, Shadow DOM and standard browser events.
whatYouWillLearn: Learn to write a message that describes your own component
Learn to change the internal paragraph message
Learn to assign the points property a new number
learningObjectives: Learn to write a message that describes your own component
